fields.name: prefixRun
fields.type: ∀ extra, ExceptT.run (SourcePruningEnumerationTerminalPrefix.run (r + extra) first rest before.waiting before.core) = [.ok ((recorded, winner, joined.waiting), joined.core)]

fields.name: movedSame
fields.type: joined.waiting = EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.moveMany winner (EnumerationBuilderCaches.canonicalIds (recorded.filter (fun key => key != winner))) before.waiting

fields.name: prefixCounts
fields.type: EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.Correct (EnumerationCanonicalUnion.mergedRoots roots recorded winner) joined.core.values joined.waiting

fields.name: cachedFoldRun
fields.type: ∀ extra P H, p ≤ P → h ≤ H → SourcePruningEnumerationCachedFold.run checkEmpty (n + extra) P H recorded beforeCaller joined winner memos.query = ((.ok (some (foldRows.map (fun row => .ok (row.1, row.2.core)))), foldCaller, foldQueries, folded.core), some folded)

fields.name: foldRun
fields.type: ∀ extra P H, p ≤ P → h ≤ H → SourcePruningEnumerationFold.run checkEmpty (n + extra) P H recorded beforeCaller joined.core winner memos.query = (.ok (some (foldRows.map (fun row => .ok (row.1, row.2.core)))), foldCaller, foldQueries, folded.core)

fields.name: foldPost
fields.type: Post formulas solver foldInventory beforeCaller foldCaller foldFinal

fields.name: foldCounts
fields.type: EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.Correct (EnumerationCanonicalUnion.mergedRoots roots recorded winner) folded.core.values folded.waiting

fields.name: foldCompleted
fields.type: foldRows = [((), folded)] → ∀ source ∈ recorded, source ≠ winner → folded.core.values[source]? = some .eliminated

fields.name: terminalRun
fields.type: ∀ extraRepresentative extraNative P H, p ≤ P → h ≤ H → SourcePruningEnumerationTerminal.run checkEmpty (r + extraRepresentative) (n + extraNative) P H first rest before.waiting beforeCaller before.core incoming incomingScs memos.query = (.ok (some raw), afterCaller, savedQueries, outer, joined.waiting)

fields.name: post
fields.type: Post formulas solver next beforeCaller afterCaller final

fields.name: rejectedBranch
fields.type: foldRows = [] → raw = [] ∧ afterCaller = foldCaller ∧ savedQueries = foldQueries ∧ outer = folded.core ∧ final = foldFinal ∧ next = foldInventory

winner).eraseDups else read.recursionAncestry other}) ∧ (after.core.values[winner]? = some (.unenumerated (some handle) (incomingScs ++ oldScs))) ∧ (StorageValid after.core) ∧ (PendingRealized afterCaller.checked.native.machine.heap after.core) ∧ (Post formulas solver next foldCaller afterCaller final) ∧ (Cache.Extends foldFinal.unfolding final.unfolding) ∧ (∀ extra, (SourcePruningEnumerationNativeIndex.write afterCaller.checked.native.machine.heap (incomingK + extra) winner (.unenumerated (some handle) (incomingScs ++ oldScs)) incomingScs [] (EnumerationExpandableIndex.frame read folded)).map (EnumerationExpandableIndex.frame after.core) = some after) ∧ (after.core.counter = folded.core.counter) ∧ (after.core.representatives = fields.name: reading
fields.type: ∀ extra, ExceptT.run (getValue (r + extra) winner folded.core) = [.ok (.unenumerated oldNode oldScs, read)]

fields.name: incomingRun
fields.type: ∀ extraRepresentative extraNative P H, p ≤ P → h ≤ H → SourcePruningEnumerationIncomingNode.run checkEmpty (r + extraRepresentative) (n + extraNative) P H foldCaller folded.core winner incoming incomingScs foldQueries = (.ok (some (if replacement = .empty then [] else [.ok ((), after.core)])), afterCaller, savedQueries, read)

fields.name: writePrefix
fields.type: ExceptT.run ((do setValue winner (.unenumerated (some handle) (incomingScs ++ oldScs)); inheritAncestry winner) read) = [.ok ((), after.core)]

fields.name: afterSame
fields.type: after.core = {read with values := read.values.set winner (.unenumerated (some handle) (incomingScs ++ oldScs)), recursionAncestry := fun other => if other = winner then (read.expansionAncestry ++ read.recursionAncestry winner).eraseDups else read.recursionAncestry other}

fields.name: incomingPost
fields.type: Post formulas solver next foldCaller afterCaller final

fields.name: cacheRun
fields.type: ∀ extra, (SourcePruningEnumerationNativeIndex.write afterCaller.checked.native.machine.heap (incomingK + extra) winner (.unenumerated (some handle) (incomingScs ++ oldScs)) incomingScs [] (EnumerationExpandableIndex.frame read folded)).map (EnumerationExpandableIndex.frame after.core) = some after

fields.name: afterCounts
fields.type: EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.Correct (EnumerationCanonicalUnion.mergedRoots roots recorded winner) after.core.values after.waiting

fields.name: writeWaiting
fields.type: after.waiting = EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.count (EnumerationCanonicalUnion.mergedRoots roots recorded winner) 1 incomingScs joined.waiting

fields.name: afterExpandable
fields.type: after.expandable = (fun slot => if slot = winner then !(MergedOrdinaryHeight.recursiveBoundary replacement && (incomingScs ++ oldScs).isEmpty) else folded.expandable slot)

fields.name: rawSame
fields.type: raw = (if replacement = .empty then [] else [.ok (.hole winner, after.core)])

fields.name: optional
fields.type: oldNode = none → replacement = incoming ∧ afterCaller = foldCaller ∧ savedQueries = foldQueries ∧ final = foldFinal ∧ next = foldInventory

fields.name: present
fields.type: ∀ oldHandle, oldNode = some oldHandle → ∃ (old query : Node) (queried : Checked width), lookupNode foldCaller.checked.native.machine.heap oldHandle = some old ∧ next.source = foldCaller.checked.native.machine.heap ∧ next.roots = foldInventory.roots ++ [incoming, old] ∧ SourceCurrentAllocatedTargetQuery.Receipt formulas solver next incoming old foldCaller.checked query queried foldFinal ∧ (∀ ambient term, InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient replacement term ↔ InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient incoming term ∧ InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient old term) ∧ (checkEmpty = false → replacement = query ∧ afterCaller = SourceCurrentAllocatedPartialState.advance foldCaller queried foldCaller.fourth foldCaller.merge ∧ final = foldFinal)

fields.name: lookup
fields.type: UnionFind.findRoot r folded.core.representatives winner = some found
